description: This file defines a Go package for Kubernetes client apply configurations related to NodeStatus, including a struct with various node status fields, constructor, and chainable setter methods.

classes.name: NodeStatusApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes NodeStatus, with fields for capacity, allocatable resources, node phase, conditions, addresses, daemon endpoints, node info, images, volumes, config, runtime handlers, features, and declared features.

methods.name: NodeStatus
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of NodeStatusApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithCapacity
methods.description: Sets the Capacity field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAllocatable
methods.description: Sets the Allocatable field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithPhase
methods.description: Sets the Phase field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithConditions
methods.description: Appends one or more NodeConditionApplyConfiguration objects to the Conditions list.

methods.name: WithAddresses
methods.description: Appends one or more NodeAddressApplyConfiguration objects to the Addresses list.

methods.name: WithImages
methods.description: Appends one or more ContainerImageApplyConfiguration objects to the Images list.

methods.name: WithVolumesInUse
methods.description: Appends volume names to the VolumesInUse list.

methods.name: WithVolumesAttached
methods.description: Appends AttachedVolumeApplyConfiguration objects to the VolumesAttached list.

methods.name: WithRuntimeHandlers
methods.description: Appends NodeRuntimeHandlerApplyConfiguration objects to the RuntimeHandlers list.

methods.name: WithDeclaredFeatures
methods.description: Appends strings to the DeclaredFeatures list.
